      And‐Or Graph

   The initial graph templates for the cheetah, swimming girls, and the frog in Experiment 4 were labeled in their first video
frames. The initial graph template G0 simply consisted of three OR nodes, each having a single terminal node. During the
mining process, more OR nodes for the AoG were automatically discovered.
